metadata.scope: assembled playable Dark characters and blockbusters; finalized shared engine cards
metadata.pairing: Each variant and its cohort baseline retain element-dark identity/orderKey; fixed opponent identity and engine seeded deck ordering are unchanged.
metadata.interpretation: Variant results depend on deck composition and automated policy. Same-cost vs cost-changing is a printed-cost classification, not a causal card-buff estimate.

inventory.name: ATL Scammer
inventory.effect: On Reveal: File a claim through next round. Divert up to 1 Motion from the next enemy refund. If unused, at expiry open a one-use local 1-Motion character discount here through next round, minimum 1. Theft or fallback, never both.

inventory.name: Chess Regular
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Mark the strongest enemy in up to two different districts through next round. With one mark, wait for an enemy placement in another district to complete the Fork. The next enemy placement after completion saves that district; other marked enemies lose 2 Hands. If a marked enemy loses Hands, Chess Regular gains +1 Hand. One Fork per side.

inventory.name: Corrupt Pastor
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Take 1 Hand from each other ally here, leaving each with at least 1. Gain 2 Hands per actual donation.

inventory.name: Shotta
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy here for 2. Ongoing: After you play another character in a different district, fire 2 at its strongest enemy. Two encores per match, at most one per round.

inventory.name: Gamer
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands ally in each other district +1 Hand. Ongoing: While on board, the first time each round you newly Silence or Weaken an enemy, your lowest-Hands Dark ally gains +2 Hands.

inventory.name: Goth Kid
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Silence the lowest-Hands enemy here with a printed cost of 3 or less.

inventory.name: Hater
inventory.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, after an enemy here gains bonus Hands, remove up to 1 of that new bonus and gain +1 Hand if any was removed. Cannot remove base Hands.

inventory.name: Incel
inventory.effect: Ongoing: At round end, if you are the only friendly character here, gain +2 Hands, at most twice per match.

inventory.name: Inmate Informant
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Give the strongest enemy here -3 Hands. Protection and immunity can block this.

inventory.name: Inmate Kingpin
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Give Contraband and +1 Hand to your weakest other Inmate anywhere; if none, Kingpin holds it for the next Inmate. Later Inmate deployments or moves pass it on; each of the first three distinct carriers gains +1 Hand. After three carriers, each survivor gains another +1. Once per Kingpin per match.

inventory.name: Lawless YN
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Move the weakest enemy here to their strongest other open district. If it moves, Lawless YN gains +1 Hand. Protection, immunity and movement locks can stop this.

inventory.name: Midnight Mayor
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Nominate your weakest other district through next round. The next friendly move there grants that mover Protection and opens one local 1-Motion character discount, minimum 1. One nomination per side.

inventory.name: Mr. Trick
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Open a Tab through next round. The next other friendly character played here becomes your guest. Its first successful enemy hit or new harmful status earns a Tip; cash it at round end for +2 Hands to the guest. One Tab per side.

inventory.name: Closet Nerd
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Silence the highest-Hands active Ongoing enemy here, otherwise the strongest enemy, bypassing Wifey's Side Eye. Protection still blocks this. Newly interrupting an active Ongoing ability grants +1 Hand and reveals one enemy hand card.

inventory.name: Queen of Hearts
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Execute the weakest enemy here if it has 4 or fewer Hands. A successful execution summons a 2-Hand Card Guard. Protection can block execution.

inventory.name: Red Pill
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Apply Weaken to the highest-Hands enemy here. If already Weakened, Silence them and gain +2 Hands instead.

inventory.name: Repo Man
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Tow the enemy with the most bonus Hands from another district here. If it arrives, give up to 3 of its bonus Hands to your weakest ally here. Protection, immunity and movement rules apply.

inventory.name: Scammer
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Copy the base Hands (up to 7) and printed ability of the strongest active Ongoing enemy here. If none exists, copy only the strongest enemy's base Hands (up to 7) and gain +1 Hand. Copied entrances never trigger.

inventory.name: Shiesty YN
inventory.effect: On Reveal: 50% chance to summon another Shiesty YN here. Each summoned copy repeats this effect, up to 8 extra.

inventory.name: Sho'Nuff
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Take up to 2 bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus Hands. If no enemy has bonus Hands, give the highest-Hands enemy here -1 Hands instead.

inventory.name: Subway Magician
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Apply Weaken to the highest-Hands enemy here, then move to your weakest other district.

inventory.name: Sugarfoot
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here. If it was already Weakened, gain +1 Hand.

inventory.name: The Block Spin
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Repeat every Hands reduction already dealt in this lane this round two more times on the same surviving characters still here. Repeated damage cannot repeat itself.

inventory.name: The Setup
inventory.effect: Sacrifice your weakest character here. Your strongest remaining character here inherits its current Hands plus 2. Requires two friendly characters.

inventory.name: The Feds
inventory.effect: On Reveal: Remove up to 4 bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most removable bonus and Lock it. If none has bonus Hands, Lock the strongest enemy. Cannot reduce below printed Hands.

inventory.name: Trap Vamp
inventory.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, when your ability damages an enemy here, gain that much Hands, up to 2.

inventory.name: Undercova Brotha
inventory.effect: Ongoing: Once per match, after the first enemy deployed here resolves its entrance, steal 1 Hand from it and escape to your weakest other open district.
